title: N65: Day-of-week VaR violations — null result (chi2=2.17, p=0.70)
description: Tested day-of-week effect in SPY VaR 1% violations (2020-2025, 22 violations in 1507 days). Mon 1.4%, Tue 0.6%, Wed 1.6%, Thu 1.7%, Fri 2.0%. Chi-squared p=0.70, no significant effect. Monday effect: p=1.000 (no difference). This confirms that VaR violations are driven by unpredictable events (consistent with Section 4.4.4 violation event analysis). No calendar-based adjustment to VaR needed.
